name: Grand Hyatt Dubai
positioning: City resort in 37 acres of gardens overlooking Dubai Creek, with a large waterpark, near the airport
best_for: Families who want a waterpark and pools within a city hotel
Travelers who want a garden resort setting near the airport

facts.text: The hotel is located near the airport and major attractions, combining resort living with city access.
The hotel has two outdoor pools and an indoor pool.
Ahasees Spa and Club experiences are guided by three core philosophies: Trade, Flourish and Evolve.
The fitness centre at Ahasees Spa and Club has separate zones with cardio and strength-training equipment.
Skyline View rooms have Dubai skyline views and contemporary decor with Arabian touches.
Rooms have an Italian bathroom with twin basins and a separate tub and shower.
Butler service is available on request in the 2 Bedroom Royal Suite.
Panini is a delicatessen set amid tropical indoor gardens and waterfalls, known for its strawberry cheesecake.
Wox serves Pan-Asian street-food-inspired dishes at an intimate chef's table where the chef cooks over woks.
The hotel has indoor and outdoor wedding venues with personalized planning.
The hotel offers 12,500 square metres of event space, from ballrooms to meeting rooms.

highlights.text: Grand Hyatt Dubai is a city resort surrounded by 37 acres of gardens overlooking Dubai Creek.
Grand Hyatt Dubai Waterpark has 16 signature attractions and is designed for all generations.
Superior rooms are adorned with Arabian influences and have views of Dubai's historic creek and parklands.
The 2 Bedroom Royal Suite has a spacious parlor, dining for eight, a kitchenette and a marble bathroom with a jetted spa bathtub.

considerations.text: The hotel is just outside of downtown Dubai rather than in it.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing for dining and spa services.
